objects.tension: The New Business Road Test pre-market domain screening vs Lean Startup rapid MVP learning
objects.route: Use domain screening when structural/fatal market risk is cheap to assess first; use MVP when uncertainty is behavioral/usage and a small test can cheaply change the decision.
Mom Test/qualitative conversation generates hypotheses; commitment/advancement and behavior-based experiments carry stronger market evidence. Compliments never upgrade E-grade.

objects.tension: Speed of experimentation vs WIP/queue overload
objects.route: Fast cycles require bounded WIP and smaller batches; more simultaneous experiments can slow evidence throughput.

objects.tension: Early exploration vs 7 Powers durable advantage
objects.route: Do not demand full Power before problem/market evidence; after repeatable value emerges, require Benefit+Barrier before scale-stage graduation.
Compare as vectors: founder cash gap, time-to-proof, control, regulatory burden, execution capability, downside, financing dependency. No magic total score.

objects.tension: Local metric gain vs system improvement
objects.route: Sterman policy-resistance scan + guardrail regression; repeated local failure triggers double-loop model/boundary review.
